segments.an4.108:1.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, balībaddā [balivaddā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), balibaddhā (ka.) pu. pa. 162].
segments.an4.108:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro balībaddūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.108:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo?
segments.an4.108:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti, no paraparisaṃ.
segments.an4.108:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo.
segments.an4.108:2.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo sagavacaṇḍo, no paragavacaṇḍo;
segments.an4.108:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo paragavacaṇḍo hoti, no sagavacaṇḍo?
segments.an4.108:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo paraparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti, no sakaparisaṃ.
segments.an4.108:3.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo paragavacaṇḍo hoti, no sagavacaṇḍo.
segments.an4.108:3.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo paragavacaṇḍo, no sagavacaṇḍo;
segments.an4.108:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo ca hoti paragavacaṇḍo ca?
segments.an4.108:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti paraparisañca.
segments.an4.108:4.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo ca hoti paragavacaṇḍo ca.
segments.an4.108:4.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo sagavacaṇḍo ca paragavacaṇḍo ca;
segments.an4.108:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva sagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo?
segments.an4.108:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo neva sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti, no paraparisañca.
segments.an4.108:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo.
segments.an4.108:5.4: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo neva sagavacaṇḍo, no paragavacaṇḍo;
segments.an4.108:5.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro balībaddūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmi”nti.

lines: Aṭṭhame yo attano gogaṇaṃ maddati, na paragogaṇaṃ, ayaṃ sagavacaṇḍo no paragavacaṇḍoti evaṃ sabbapadāni veditabbāni.
Aṭṭhame balībaddo tāva yo attano gogaṇaṃ ghaṭṭeti ubbejeti, paragoṇe pana sūrato sukhasīlo hoti, ayaṃ sagavacaṇḍo no paragavacaṇḍo nāma.
Puggalopi attano parisaṃ ghaṭṭento vijjhanto pharuse samudācaranto, paraparisāya pana soraccaṃ nivātavuttitaṃ āpajjanto sagavacaṇḍo nāmāti iminā nayena sesāpi veditabbā.
